body:
GREG, 2026-11-21 about 16:14Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1760, message 7da80559), verbatim: „+ Engram::Inquisitor
takie podejscie do designu ma zostac usunieta

NIE MA HIPOTETYCZNYCH SYTUACJI, NIE DA SIE PRZED TYM ZABEZPIECZYC

ktory model wymysla takie rzeczy”.
Context: Greg was answering the w-952b design, a handle-level proof that the store file SQLite holds is the one at the pinned path, built against a file being swapped under a live process.
RULE for both projects: do not design, require or accept protections against hypothetical scenarios, such as a file swapped or renamed under a live process, a re-pointed symlink or junction, a concurrent config writer, or cross-device inode reuse. A review finding whose only trigger is such a scenario is rejected, not fixed and not escalated as a blocker. Design for real recovery behaviour with the simplest mechanism. State any accepted limit in one line, and add no new layer.
Provenance of the w-952b and w-e96f approach (2026-10-31), from the item history:
- the Codex reviewers' round-1 and round-4 Highs and a Codex explorer (delegation-693addd9) raised the swap, reparse and hard-link scenarios;
- the implementer Engram::Opus (Claude Opus) revised the criteria;
- the coordinator Engram::Fable (Claude Opus) accepted those findings, wrote the fail-closed criterion wording (#3672, #3680, #3685, #3688) and created w-952b as a P0 "required proof". The approval was Fable's.

GREG, about 16:18Z, relayed by Asistant 43498a6e #1764 (message 5a43893a), verbatim: „1. chce wiedziec jak uniknac takich decyzji 2. prosze uszunac to szalenstwo w kodzie”.
HOW WE AVOID IT, with no new process or gate:
- Every protection, check or fail-closed refusal names its concrete need, meaning a real failure that has been observed, together with its cost. If it can't, it doesn't go in.
- A reviewer or explorer finding that asks for a new protection must name that observed failure. A finding resting only on "someone could swap, rename or race this" is rejected at consolidation, with the reason recorded. It is not fixed and not escalated as a blocker.
- Coordinators, Fable first, apply this when ruling on criteria. Fable accepted such findings repeatedly on w-e96f and w-952b; that is the failure this rule prevents.
REMOVAL owners: w-952b (11334) deletes control_connection_read entirely; w-5a44 (Engram::Opus, with Engram::Inquisitor classifying read-only) handles the same_file and share-mode pinning in backup/restore.rs, graph/publication.rs and source_identity.rs, and the file_identity checks in src/task_sync/setup/materialize/{replacement,journal,completion}.

GREG, about 16:23Z, relayed by Asistant 43498a6e #1767 (message dfd344f8), verbatim: „Musimy stosowac ta regulę. Moge wymienic ile razy stworzylismy kod, który po takich 'upewnieniach' nie działa”. A High rating by itself is not a requirement. Design starts from the concrete goal, the real problem and its cost. Remove unneeded layers, and keep the behaviour and the repair of real failures.
First applied, 2026-11-21:
- d895's filter-driver-key recheck, which guarded against a concurrent config writer, is removed (Fable to 12325);
- w-952b is cancelled and control_connection_read deleted (11334);
- w-5a44 removes the file-identity pinning (Opus).
